name: Madam's Maid
source: Assigned to serving your employers niece, your new Madam. A demanding, dominant woman who has no issue manipulating her new toy to meet her every need. You arrive expecting to serve and clean, just as you've done previously for the lady of the house. But you soon find yourself being led into perversion by someone who lives in their own little world and has all the intention of pulling you into it.
translation: 被指派为你的雇主侄女、你的新夫人服务。一位要求严格、占主导地位的女性，可以毫不犹豫地操纵她的新玩具来满足她的每一个需要。你到达时期望提供服务和清洁，就像你之前为女主人所做的那样。但你很快就会发现自己被一个生活在自己的小世界里、并且一心想把你拉进去的人带入了变态。
